popularTours.title: Popular tours
popularTours.subtitle: We offer a variety of tours across Montenegro — from the coast to the mountains.

toursPage.title: Private tours of Montenegro
toursPage.subtitle: Choose one of our carefully crafted tours with a private driver and discover the most beautiful parts of the country at your own pace.

ada-bojana.title: Ada Bojana
ada-bojana.shortDescription: A unique river island in southern Montenegro, a paradise for nature lovers.
ada-bojana.description: Ada Bojana is a triangular river island at the mouth of the Bojana river. Famous for wild beaches, fresh fish restaurants and a relaxed atmosphere.

andrijevica.title: Andrijevica
andrijevica.shortDescription: A mountain town at the entrance to the Lim canyon, gateway to the Prokletije mountains.
andrijevica.description: Andrijevica is a peaceful mountain town along the Lim river, known as the starting point for excursions into Prokletije National Park.

banja-luka.title: Banja Luka
banja-luka.shortDescription: Administrative centre of Republika Srpska with Kastel fortress and a vibrant bazaar.
banja-luka.description: Banja Luka is the second largest city in Bosnia and Herzegovina, located on the banks of the Vrbas river. Visit Kastel fortress and enjoy rafting.

bar.title: Bar
bar.shortDescription: Montenegro's largest port with ruins of Old Bar and an olive tree two thousand years old.
bar.description: Bar is a vibrant coastal town known for its old town, ancient olive grove and lively port. Old Bar is an archaeological gem.

belgrade.title: Belgrade
belgrade.shortDescription: Serbia's vibrant capital at the confluence of the Sava and Danube — Kalemegdan, Skadarlija and nightlife.
belgrade.description: Belgrade is one of the oldest cities in Europe. Visit the mighty Kalemegdan fortress and stroll through the bohemian Skadarlija quarter.

berane.title: Berane
berane.shortDescription: A town on the Lim river surrounded by mountains, with rich history and the Đurđevi Stupovi monastery.
berane.description: Berane is a town in northern Montenegro in the Berane valley along the Lim river. Nearby is the Đurđevi Stupovi monastery.

bijelo-polje.title: Bijelo Polje
bijelo-polje.shortDescription: Northern Montenegrin town surrounded by the Lim and Bistrica rivers, gateway to the mountains.
bijelo-polje.description: Bijelo Polje is the administrative centre of northern Montenegro, located at the confluence of the Bistrica and Lim rivers.

bileca.title: Bileća
bileca.shortDescription: A town on the shore of Bileća Lake — one of the largest artificial lakes in the Balkans.
bileca.description: Bileća is a Herzegovinian town known for Bileća Lake, an artificial reservoir created by the Grančarevo hydroelectric dam.

budva.title: Budva
budva.shortDescription: Tourist capital of the Montenegrin coast with the famous Old Town and beaches.
budva.description: Budva is Montenegro's most famous tourist destination. The Old Town surrounded by Venetian walls and crystal clear sea await you.

cetinje.title: Cetinje
cetinje.shortDescription: Historical capital of Montenegro with palaces, museums and a monastery.
cetinje.description: Cetinje is the spiritual and cultural capital of Montenegro. Visit Cetinje Monastery and the Palace of King Nikola.

cacak.title: Čačak
cacak.shortDescription: Serbian town on the Morava known for fruit growing, culture and the Ovčar-Kablar canyon.
cacak.description: Čačak is one of the largest cities in central Serbia, known for cultural institutions and the Ovčar-Kablar canyon.

dubrovnik-airport.title: Dubrovnik Airport
dubrovnik-airport.shortDescription: Fast and comfortable transfer to Dubrovnik Airport without stress or waiting.
dubrovnik-airport.description: Comfortable private transfer from Podgorica to Dubrovnik Airport (Čilipi). Your driver will meet you and take you directly to the terminal.

durres.title: Durrës
durres.shortDescription: Ancient Albanian port city with a Roman amphitheatre and beautiful Adriatic beaches.
durres.description: Durrës is Albania's second largest city. It preserves an impressive Roman amphitheatre from the 2nd century and a rich history.

dubrovnik-city.title: Dubrovnik
dubrovnik-city.shortDescription: The Pearl of the Adriatic — city walls, Stradun and crystal clear sea of a UNESCO gem.
dubrovnik-city.description: Dubrovnik is one of the most beautiful cities on the Mediterranean, protected by UNESCO. Walk the ancient walls and visit Stradun.

foca.title: Foča
foca.shortDescription: City on the Drina and Tara — Bosnia and Herzegovina's rafting centre with unspoiled nature.
foca.description: Foča is a Bosnian-Herzegovinian town at the confluence of the Tara and Drina rivers, known as one of the best rafting destinations.

gusinje.title: Gusinje
gusinje.shortDescription: Hidden gem beside Plav lake and the Albanian Alps — the Prokletije within reach.
gusinje.description: Gusinje is a small town in eastern Montenegro, nestled at the foot of the Prokletije mountains surrounded by crystal rivers.

herceg-novi.title: Herceg Novi
herceg-novi.shortDescription: The flower city at the entrance to the Bay of Kotor with fortresses and Mediterranean charm.
herceg-novi.description: Herceg Novi is a town at the entrance to the Bay of Kotor, known for lush Mediterranean vegetation and historic fortresses.

igalo.title: Igalo
igalo.shortDescription: Famous spa resort in the Bay of Kotor with healing mud and thalassotherapy.
igalo.description: Igalo is a well-known health resort in Herceg Novi, famous for its therapeutic sea mud and thalassotherapy treatments.

jaz.title: Jaz Beach
jaz.shortDescription: One of the most famous and beautiful beaches in Montenegro, just next to Budva.
jaz.description: Jaz is a wide sandy beach near Budva, known for its clear sea and famous music festivals held there in summer.

kolasin.title: Kolašin
kolasin.shortDescription: Mountain winter resort with ski slopes and the unspoiled nature of Bjelasica.
kolasin.description: Kolašin is a popular mountain destination in central Montenegro, known for its ski resort and Biogradska Gora National Park.

kopaonik.title: Kopaonik
kopaonik.shortDescription: Serbia's largest mountain and ski resort — the Sunny Mountain with 55 slopes.
kopaonik.description: Kopaonik is a national park and Serbia's most famous ski destination with 55 slopes totalling 75 km in length.

kotor.title: Kotor
kotor.shortDescription: Kotor Old Town, a UNESCO World Heritage Site in the heart of the Bay of Kotor.
kotor.description: Discover the most beautiful bay in the Mediterranean. Visit UNESCO-listed Kotor Old Town and picturesque Perast and Risan.

mojkovac.title: Mojkovac
mojkovac.shortDescription: A town of heroes on the Tara, known for the Battle of Mojkovac and canyon scenery.
mojkovac.description: Mojkovac is a town in northern Montenegro along the Tara river, known for the spectacular Tara canyon.

mostar.title: Mostar
mostar.shortDescription: City of the Old Bridge — symbol of renewal and coexistence on the banks of the green Neretva.
mostar.description: Mostar is one of the most beautiful cities in the Balkans, known for its 16th-century Old Bridge, a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

niksic.title: Nikšić
niksic.shortDescription: Montenegro's second city with Bedem fortress, Slano lake and famous beer.
niksic.description: Nikšić is Montenegro's second largest city, known for Bedem fortress and the famous Nikšić brewery founded in 1896.

nis.title: Niš
nis.shortDescription: Serbia's third city, birthplace of Constantine the Great, with fortress and Skull Tower.
nis.description: Niš is one of the oldest cities in the Balkans and birthplace of Emperor Constantine the Great. Visit the fortress and the chilling Skull Tower.

novi-sad.title: Novi Sad
novi-sad.shortDescription: Vojvodina's capital with Petrovaradin fortress and the famous Exit festival.
novi-sad.description: Novi Sad is Serbia's second largest city on the banks of the Danube. Petrovaradin fortress and the colourful Old Town are unmissable.

ohrid.title: Ohrid
ohrid.shortDescription: Macedonian gem on the shores of Lake Ohrid — UNESCO heritage on water.
ohrid.description: Ohrid is one of the oldest cities in Europe and Macedonia's cultural capital on the shores of Lake Ohrid.

ostrog.title: Ostrog Monastery
ostrog.shortDescription: A miracle in the rock — the most visited shrine in the Balkans hangs above the Zeta gorges.
ostrog.description: Ostrog Monastery is built into a vertical cliff at 900 metres altitude. It houses the relics of Saint Vasilije of Ostrog.

pec.title: Peć (Peja)
pec.shortDescription: Kosovo town at the foot of the Prokletije with the famous Patriarchate and Rugova canyon.
pec.description: Peć is a town in Kosovo at the entrance to the Rugova canyon. The Patriarchate of Peć is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

perast.title: Perast
perast.shortDescription: The baroque gem of the Bay of Kotor with two islands and a breathtaking view.
perast.description: Perast is a small baroque town on the shore of the Bay of Kotor, known for the islands of Our Lady of the Rocks and St. George.

petrovac-tunnel.title: Petrovac (tunnel route)
petrovac-tunnel.shortDescription: Picturesque coastal town with pine forests, ancient ruins and turquoise sea.
petrovac-tunnel.description: Petrovac na Moru is one of Montenegro's most beautiful coastal towns, surrounded by pine forests and pebble beaches.

petrovac-mountain.title: Petrovac (mountain route)
petrovac-mountain.shortDescription: Scenic drive through the Montenegrin hinterland — old road past olive groves and villages.
petrovac-mountain.description: The old mountain road to Petrovac offers unforgettable views of the Montenegrin coast and interior, past authentic villages.

plav.title: Plav
plav.shortDescription: Plav lake at the foot of the Prokletije — alpine beauty in eastern Montenegro.
plav.description: Plav is a town in eastern Montenegro beside Plav lake at the foot of the Prokletije mountains.

pljevlja.title: Pljevlja
pljevlja.shortDescription: Northern town with the Holy Trinity Monastery and cultural heritage of northern Montenegro.
pljevlja.description: Pljevlja is located in the far north of Montenegro, known for the 15th-century Holy Trinity Monastery with its valuable library.

prijepolje.title: Prijepolje
prijepolje.shortDescription: Serbian town on the Lim with Mileševa monastery and the famous White Angel fresco.
prijepolje.description: Prijepolje is a town in southwestern Serbia on the Lim river. Nearby is Mileševa Monastery with the famous White Angel fresco.

pristina.title: Pristina
pristina.shortDescription: Young Kosovo capital with a colourful bazaar, modern architecture and a vibrant scene.
pristina.description: Pristina is the capital of Kosovo, one of the youngest and fastest growing cities in the Balkans.

risan.title: Risan
risan.shortDescription: The oldest town in the Bay of Kotor with Roman mosaics and ancient history.
risan.description: Risan is the oldest town in the Bay of Kotor, known for Roman mosaics from the 2nd century and the Illyrian fortress.

rozaje.title: Rožaje
rozaje.shortDescription: Bosniak town in the heart of the Pešter plateau surrounded by mountains and forests.
rozaje.description: Rožaje is a town in northeastern Montenegro, known for authentic Bosniak culture and unspoiled nature.

sarajevo.title: Sarajevo
sarajevo.shortDescription: The Bosnian Jerusalem — where East meets West at the famous Baščaršija bazaar.
sarajevo.description: Sarajevo is one of the most original cities in Europe, where Islamic, Catholic, Orthodox and Jewish cultures live side by side.

shkoder.title: Shkodër
shkoder.shortDescription: Albanian cultural centre beside Lake Shkodër with the impressive Rozafa fortress.
shkoder.description: Shkodër is one of the oldest cities in Albania. The Rozafa fortress with its view over Lake Shkodër is one of the most impressive in the region.

skopje.title: Skopje
skopje.shortDescription: Macedonian capital with an unusual mix of ancient sculptures and Ottoman heritage.
skopje.description: Skopje is the capital of North Macedonia. The Old Bazaar and Stone Bridge preserve the true face of this Balkan city.

sutomore.title: Sutomore
sutomore.shortDescription: Popular coastal destination with a long sandy beach and beautiful sea.
sutomore.description: Sutomore is a coastal town near Bar, known for one of the longest sandy beaches on the Montenegrin coast.

sveti-stefan.title: Sveti Stefan
sveti-stefan.shortDescription: Iconic island hotel on the Montenegrin coast — symbol of luxury on the Adriatic.
sveti-stefan.description: Sveti Stefan is a small island peninsula near Budva, a recognisable symbol of Montenegrin tourism and luxury.

savnik.title: Šavnik
savnik.shortDescription: Montenegro's smallest town in the heart of the Durmitor region with unspoiled wilderness.
savnik.description: Šavnik is Montenegro's smallest town, nestled in a valley surrounded by mountains, an ideal base for the Komarnica canyon.

tirana-airport.title: Tirana Airport
tirana-airport.shortDescription: Comfortable direct transfer to Tirana's Mother Teresa International Airport.
tirana-airport.description: Private transfer from Podgorica to Tirana Airport (Rinas). Your driver meets you and takes you directly to the departure terminal.

tirana-city.title: Tirana
tirana-city.shortDescription: Albania's colourful capital on the rise — Skanderbeg Square, bunkers and vibrant culture.
tirana-city.description: Tirana is one of the fastest-changing capitals in Europe, with a vibrant café scene and colourful building facades.

tivat.title: Tivat
tivat.shortDescription: Modern Porto Montenegro marina and Mediterranean town in the heart of the Bay of Kotor.
tivat.description: Tivat is a coastal town in the Bay of Kotor, known for the luxury Porto Montenegro marina attracting yachts from around the world.

trebinje.title: Trebinje
trebinje.shortDescription: Bosnia's sunniest town with the old town, plane trees and the Herzegovinian Gračanica.
trebinje.description: Trebinje is a Herzegovinian town on the Trebišnjica river, known as the sunniest town in the region with a beautiful old core.

ulcinj.title: Ulcinj
ulcinj.shortDescription: Montenegro's southernmost town with the famous Great Beach and Oriental heritage.
ulcinj.description: Ulcinj is Montenegro's southernmost town, known for the long sandy Great Beach and strong Oriental heritage.

uzice.title: Užice
uzice.shortDescription: Serbian town on the Đetinja with the Old Town fortress and rich Partisan history.
uzice.description: Užice is a town in western Serbia on the Đetinja river, known for the Partisan Republic of Užice in World War II.

valjevo.title: Valjevo
valjevo.shortDescription: Serbian town on the Kolubara with the Tešnjar bazaar, craft heritage and surrounding nature.
valjevo.description: Valjevo is a town in western Serbia known for the Tešnjar bazaar, one of the best-preserved old bazaars in Serbia.

zlatibor.title: Zlatibor
zlatibor.shortDescription: Beloved Serbian mountain resort with fresh air, green plateaus and heritage sites.
zlatibor.description: Zlatibor is one of Serbia's most popular mountain destinations, known for its clean mountain air and mild climate.

zabljak.title: Žabljak and Durmitor
zabljak.shortDescription: The wild and rugged Durmitor is one of the masterpieces of Montenegrin nature.
zabljak.description: A journey to Durmitor National Park, Black Lake and the Tara canyon — the deepest canyon in Europe.

skadar.title: Lake Skadar
skadar.shortDescription: A hidden wonder waiting to be explored — the largest lake in the Balkans.
skadar.description: A cruise on the largest lake in the Balkans through untouched nature and bird habitats, with wine tasting at local wineries.

about.storyP2: Our drivers are not just professionals behind the wheel, but real guides who are happy to share stories, tips and recommendations about our country. Whether we drive you from the airport to the hotel or on a full-day tour, we strive to make every kilometre enjoyable.
